promptEs: El acorde suena Mi, Sol, Si y Re, de grave a agudo. ¿Qué cifrado latino le corresponde?
promptEn: The chord sounds E, G, B and D, from low to high. Which American chord symbol matches it?
explanationEs: Mi es la fundamental; Mi-Sol es una tercera menor, Mi-Si una quinta justa y Mi-Re una séptima menor. La calidad es menor con séptima menor: Mim7. En americano se escribe Em7.
explanationEn: E is the root; E-G is a minor third, E-B a perfect fifth and E-D a minor seventh. The quality is minor with a minor seventh: Em7. In Latin notation it is written Mim7.
